subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + clarification on split audit period and minimal evidence
messages:
From: Martin Lowe <mlowe@acme-fashion.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-fashion.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing our third-party review and need your SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter) that covers our expected audit window. Two quick clarifications: 1) Our procurement team expects coverage for a split audit period (we define it as 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31). Can you confirm if Redwood's Type II report covers a split period or provide guidance? 2) To speed review, can you supply a minimal evidence snapshot (examples: short token/usage telemetry sample, retention policy excerpt, user access matrix screenshot) we can include in our packet?

If you have a standard bridge letter that confirms there are no changes outside the period of coverage, that would help too. Our timeline is tight — would appreciate replies in 48 hours if possible.

Regards,
Martin
Security Analyst — Acme Fashion

P.S. preferred transfer: S3 presigned link or secure SharePoint.

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Martin Lowe <mlowe@acme-fashion.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period question

Hi Martin — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answers up front: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter; we also can supply a compact "evidence snapshot" for procurement. A few specifics so we give exactly what you need: 

- Audit period: our Type II report covers a continuous audit period (our latest covers 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30). For split-period requests we provide one of two options: (A) the published Type II report that covers a contiguous window and a short bridge letter clarifying coverage for the remainder, or (B) a coverage statement plus attestation for the second half if requested (requires an internal attestation step and may add 3–5 business days).

- Minimal evidence snapshot we can produce (recommended compact set): 
  • 7-day token/activity sample (anonymized) — CSV/JSON snippet
  • Data retention policy excerpt (PDF)
  • Access-control matrix screenshot (IAM roles list)
  • A sample log snippet showing retention/timestamps (redacted)

- Transfer options: presigned S3 (preferred), secure SharePoint link, or encrypted Box transfer. We will not send raw PII — samples are redacted.

Attachments I'm including: bridge_letter-template.docx (editable draft) and a redacted sample of our Type II (redwood_soc2_typeii_sample-redacted.pdf). If you confirm you prefer option A (report + bridge letter) I'll send the presigned S3 link for the artifacts and a short one-line reply set you can paste into your procurement packet.

One-line reply templates (you can use these directly):
  • "Redwood provided redacted SOC 2 Type II report (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) and a bridge letter confirming coverage validity through our requested window."
  • "Included minimal evidence snapshot: 7-day activity sample (anonymized), retention policy excerpt, and access control snapshot; artifacts transferred via presigned S3."

If you want the faster path, say "Option A + presigned S3" and I'll push the transfer.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
